Andhra flavour, served with fire

Mayura carries the taste of Andhra to Bengaluru: gongura, green chilli, tamarind and freshly ground podis, served the way they are meant to be, on a banana leaf.

The tandoor adds smoke to the story. Kababs and tikkas come off the grill marinated in herbs, pachimirchi and spice, and pair with a properly cold drink from the bar.

Three ways to sit down

The Bar

A honeycomb-fronted counter, cold beer and everything you need to toast the evening.
